title: Unit extra degeneracies after applying the right adjoint
statement:
Let $F:\mathcal S\rightleftarrows\mathcal A:U$ be an adjunction of ordinary categories, with unit $\eta$ and counit $\epsilon$. Put $G=FU$ and $\delta=F\eta U$. Let $X_\bullet$ be a supplied standard augmented simplicial resolution of $(G,\epsilon,\delta)$ in endofunctors of $\mathcal A$, with the conventions of [def-trf-comonad-standard-resolution]. For $a\in\mathcal A$ set $Z_n(a)=UX_n(a)=UG^{n+1}a$ for $n\geq0$, $Z_{-1}(a)=Ua$, and let $e:Z_\bullet(a)\to\operatorname{const}(Ua)$ be the right-adjoint image of the augmentation. With $G^0=\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal A}$ define
$$h_{-1}(a)=\eta_{Ua},\qquad h_n(a)=\eta_{UG^{n+1}a}:Z_n(a)\to Z_{n+1}(a)\quad(n\geq0).$$
These maps satisfy all the left extra-degeneracy equations:
$$e_0h_{-1}=1_{Ua},\qquad d_0h_n=1_{Z_n},\qquad d_1h_0=h_{-1}e_0,$$
$$d_{i+1}h_{n+1}=h_nd_i\quad(n\geq0,\ 0\leq i\leq n+1),\qquad s_{i+1}h_n=h_{n+1}s_i\quad(n\geq0,\ 0\leq i\leq n).$$
Here faces and degeneracies are those of $Z$, and compositions are written in functional order. Every displayed map and equality is natural in $a$; equivalently these are extra-degeneracy data in the functor category $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal A,\mathcal S)$.

source.place: Tag 08ND, lemma-standard-simplicial-homotopy, in Situation 08N9 (situation-adjoint-functors); auxiliary extra-degeneracy argument for the standard object of Tag 08NC (lemma-standard-simplicial). Returned proof step 3: the unit at each underlying term satisfies every left extra-degeneracy equation, including augmented degree -1 and parameter naturality.

proof.text: Write $D_i^m=U(G^i\epsilon G^{m-i})_a:Z_m(a)\to Z_{m-1}(a)$ for $m\geq1$ and $S_i^m=U(G^i\delta G^{m-i})_a$ for $m\geq0$. These are precisely the operators prescribed by [def-trf-comonad-standard-resolution], and $e_0=U\epsilon_a$. The maps $h_n$ have the required types since $UF(UG^{n+1}a)=UG^{n+2}a$. We use functional composition. The adjunction data include $U\epsilon_b\circ\eta_{Ub}=1_{Ub}$ and naturality $UF(q)\circ\eta_v=\eta_w\circ q$ for every $q:v\to w$ in $\mathcal S$; these are the triangle and natural-transformation axioms, respectively.

source.place: Tags 08N9/08NC/08ND, situation-adjoint-functors, lemma-standard-simplicial, lemma-standard-simplicial-homotopy; equation-composition and the displayed standard face/degeneracy formulas. Explicit elementary unit-naturality calculations.

proof.text: Apply the right triangle identity at $b=a$ to obtain $e_0h_{-1}=U\epsilon_a\circ\eta_{Ua}=1_{Ua}$. For every $n\geq0$, the prescribed zeroth face in degree $n+1$ is $D_0^{n+1}=U\epsilon_{G^{n+1}a}$. The same triangle identity at $b=G^{n+1}a$ gives $D_0^{n+1}h_n=1_{UG^{n+1}a}$, including $n=0$.

source.place: Tags 08N9/08NC/08ND, situation-adjoint-functors, lemma-standard-simplicial, lemma-standard-simplicial-homotopy; equation-composition and the displayed standard face/degeneracy formulas. Explicit elementary unit-naturality calculations.

proof.text: The other face out of degree one is $D_1^1=UG(\epsilon_a)=UF(U\epsilon_a)$. Apply unit naturality to the morphism $q=U\epsilon_a:UGa\to Ua$ to obtain $D_1^1h_0=UF(U\epsilon_a)\circ\eta_{UGa}=\eta_{Ua}\circ U\epsilon_a=h_{-1}e_0$. This separately verifies the augmented boundary equation without invoking a nonexistent face out of degree zero.

source.place: Tags 08N9/08NC/08ND, situation-adjoint-functors, lemma-standard-simplicial, lemma-standard-simplicial-homotopy; equation-composition and the displayed standard face/degeneracy formulas. Explicit elementary unit-naturality calculations.

proof.text: For $n\geq0$ and $0\leq i\leq n+1$, the prescribed formulas give $D_{i+1}^{n+2}=UF(D_i^{n+1})$: both sides are $UG^{i+1}(\epsilon_{G^{n+1-i}a})$. Unit naturality for $q=D_i^{n+1}:UG^{n+2}a\to UG^{n+1}a$ therefore gives $D_{i+1}^{n+2}h_{n+1}=UF(D_i^{n+1})\eta_{UG^{n+2}a}=\eta_{UG^{n+1}a}D_i^{n+1}=h_nD_i^{n+1}$. The formula also holds at the extreme index $i=n+1$, where $G^0$ is the identity.

source.place: Tags 08N9/08NC/08ND, situation-adjoint-functors, lemma-standard-simplicial, lemma-standard-simplicial-homotopy; equation-composition and the displayed standard face/degeneracy formulas. Explicit elementary unit-naturality calculations.

proof.text: For $n\geq0$ and $0\leq i\leq n$, the prescribed degeneracies give $S_{i+1}^{n+1}=UF(S_i^n)$: both sides equal $UG^{i+1}(\delta_{G^{n-i}a})$. Unit naturality for $q=S_i^n:UG^{n+1}a\to UG^{n+2}a$ gives $S_{i+1}^{n+1}h_n=UF(S_i^n)\eta_{UG^{n+1}a}=\eta_{UG^{n+2}a}S_i^n=h_{n+1}S_i^n$, also for $n=i=0$.

source.place: Tags 08N9/08NC/08ND, situation-adjoint-functors, lemma-standard-simplicial, lemma-standard-simplicial-homotopy; equation-composition and the displayed standard face/degeneracy formulas. Explicit elementary unit-naturality calculations.

proof.text: For a morphism $f:a\to b$ and $n\geq-1$, unit naturality applied to $q=UG^{n+1}(f)$ gives $UG^{n+2}(f)\circ h_n(a)=h_n(b)\circ UG^{n+1}(f)$ (at $n=-1$, this reads $UG(f)\eta_{Ua}=\eta_{Ub}U(f)$). Thus the $h_n$ are natural transformations in the parameter. The faces, degeneracies and augmentation are natural transformations by the supplied resolution and its prescribed operators. The previous pointwise equalities consequently hold as equalities of natural transformations in $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal A,\mathcal S)$, since their components agree at every object.
